name: Directory
description: A browsable set of people, places or things with a picture and contact details.

for: Trusted vendors, restaurants or contacts with a picture and a phone number
A collection looked up by name or kind: plants, tools, places
Cards with search and a kind filter, and a page per entry
A household's address book of services
notFor: Rows with a status to follow up (use tracker)
Deals or candidates moving through stages (use pipeline)
Entries with no contact details or picture to show
